ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Scoda Tubes Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
General Updates — Scoda Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in Name of Secretarial Auditor

Appointment — Scoda Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of M/s. HVG & Associates, Chartered Accountant, Ahmedabad (FRN: 135242W) as an Internal Auditor of the Company for conducting the Internal Audit for the financial year 2026-27
Appointment — Scoda Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Manish B. Analkat as cost auditor of the company for the cost audit of the financial year 2026-27.

Change in Management — Scoda Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about 1. Appointed Mr. Manish B. Analkat, Cost Accountant (Membership No. 19378), as cost Auditor of the Company for the cost audit of the financial year 2026-27 and 2. Appointed M/s. HVG & Associates, Chartered Accountant, Ahmedab
